sentences.japanese: 今日は爽やかな日だね。
適度な運動をすれば、心身共に爽やかになれますよ。
sentences.english: Moderate exercise will refresh both mind and body.

sentences.japanese: 暑い天候のとき、コップ１杯の冷たい水はとても爽やかだ。
sentences.english: A glass of cold water is very refreshing in hot weather.

sentences.japanese: 今日、通りで爽やかな香りの人とすれ違った。
sentences.english: Today I passed a person on the street wearing a refreshing fragrance.

sentences.japanese: トムは爽やかで素直な好青年だ。
sentences.english: Tom is refreshing, honest and a good young man.
